subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should maintainers rebase the secure Tailscale and auth-copy pieces onto current main, or close this conflicting branch in favor of a new focused PR?
rationale: The branch has a protected maintainer label, conflicts with current main, and changes security-sensitive first-run gateway setup behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent integration shape.

options.title: Rebase focused pieces onto main
options.body: Carry forward the raw 100.x block and auth recovery copy while preserving current main's onboarding refresh, setup-link staging, and typography contract.

options.title: Close for a narrow replacement
options.body: If the conflict is too expensive, close this branch and ask for a smaller PR against current main that only adds the unique secure Tailscale/auth behavior.

options.title: Accept after manual conflict resolution
options.body: Maintainers may own the broader UX replacement, but should require explicit security and first-run proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Rebase focused pieces onto main
recommendation.body: Carry forward the raw 100.x block and auth recovery copy while preserving current main's onboarding refresh, setup-link staging, and typography contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent current-main history touches the same iOS onboarding and gateway files that must be reconciled.
